steps.action: record source commit (audit_commit) and expect SHA; import only if all bindings match.
abort import; restore audit-source from the verified snapshot; report NOT_IMPORTED.
revert development branch to the pre-import commit; keep main untouched; log evidence; do NOT advance to Post-Import Audit.
freeze development; escalate to Jovi; never enable production/payment/Xianyu/n8n.

strategy: The controlled repo keeps main + development only; every import is a committed, reviewable change. No force-push, no history rewrite.
trigger: Any exact-byte mismatch, any regression failure in R6 synthetic verification, or any Jovi override.
